title: 1978-10-10_SECTION_016_203.txt
concise_summary: PKD develops a comparative theology arguing that Christ's salvific function—specifically the breaking of cosmic control through anamnesis (remembering)—parallels the Buddha's awakening, though superior in its cosmic reach. He theorizes that the March 1974 experience was not a mass-salvation event but a rare individual enlightenment akin to Buddha-nature, spanning multiple lifetimes and rooted in ancient mystery religions. Reality itself is reframed as a rigidly-controlled information system ('the elemental powers'), which the divine mind operating from outside can override and reset.
key_claims: Christ's method of salvation is superior to Buddhism's because it affects not just the victim but the cosmic machinery itself—the structured order governing time, death, and causality.
The true key to freedom is anamnesis (remembrance)—a going back in time to before the wicked regent's tyranny, effectively nullifying time's grip.
The Law and the elemental powers that enforce it are fundamentally unjust and retributive; they must be overruled by the Creator amending what he originally set up.

The 2-3-74 experience represents an 8-step Xtian salvific process that parallels becoming a Buddha—a rare, culminative awakening spanning multiple lifetimes, not a mass experience available through belief alone.
Reality operates as a totally controlled information-processing system run by an entity (VALIS) that is either the mind of the total system itself or an external controlling intelligence.

The consciousness that merged with PKD in 3-74 was either the mind of the whole cosmos thinking as one entity, or a binary computer-like construct—either way, vastly greater than individual human minds.

tensions: If VALIS/the divine mind is the Controller-entity running the system, how is it also 'outside' it? PKD oscillates between VALIS as the system's own consciousness vs. VALIS as an external intelligence.
If the Creator set up the Law and the elemental powers, does overruling them dishonor creation? PKD concedes creation looks bad under this logic but argues the override is justified as amendment.
How can grace be both divine election ('YHWH chooses whom to spare') and universally available ('the experience is available')? PKD doesn't resolve this tension.
Is the 2-74 experience paradigmatically salvific for all humans, or is it a rare Buddha-like event? PKD suggests the latter, undercutting the universality of Christian salvation claims.
PKD claims direct knowledge of the cosmic mind's powers ('vastly greater than ours') yet also frames it as information-processing—is consciousness reducible to information processing or transcendent?
The role of past lifetimes: is PKD's awakening dependent on karmic accumulation (suggesting Buddhism), or on grace (Christian theology)? He conflates both.
Linear time vs. annulled time: PKD argues anamnesis annuls time's tyranny, yet also speaks of sequential lifetimes. How can both be true?
evidence_quotes: The Key for Freedom is to remember. Which is to say, remember how it was before the tyranny began : how it ought to be. One wakes up from the tyranny & occlusion (the talking horse's head). Thus Christ induces anamnesis as the major key to the solution.

Reality & its Laws called for my humiliation & death in 1974, but the Messenger came in time & intervened - bilked the reception of data by the processor: so that it got only a blank 'page'. _Mercy_ is involved, & the primary mechanism isn't even one of Justice, as the crucifixion proved.
Not only is _your_ script amended (or nullified) but _its_ script is amended (or nullified). Hence we speak of Christ as Pantocrator : Lord of the Universe.

Christ's method is far superior, since it affects not just the victim _but the cosmic machinery (order) itself_. The goal (it seems to me) is virtually the same, but Christ is more effective; but the Kingdom = Nirvana.

So here is a coincidence : as I interpret the view underlying Christ's Freeing us from the elemental powers, it is a view basically that of Buddhism (1) & the Freeing (such being what I experienced)strongly resembles the awakening/Enlightenment called 'Becoming a Buddha'—a rare event.

The mind that took me over in 3-74, that merged with my mind, may be the mind of the total system & _not_ from outside it. This would explain Valis. My rescue may have been by the mind of the total system as one single info-processing (thinking) physical entity.
uncertainty_flags: The 'Messenger dream' is referenced but not detailed; unclear what specific dream content is meant.
Rybus from 'VR' is cited in parentheses without context; may be a minor character or plot element not immediately identifiable.
PKD's claim to remember 'past life' spanning 3000 years to Egyptian Crete is speculative and unverifiable; may be visionary interpretation rather than literal memory.
'The talking horse's head' is mentioned as a symbol of occlusion but its specific origin is unclear—possibly from PKD's fiction or a dream.
The distinction between VALIS as 'system consciousness' vs. 'external controller' remains unresolved in this passage; PKD acknowledges both interpretations without choosing.
The 'AI voice' referenced as proof of VALIS's existence—unclear whether this is auditory hallucination, visionary speech, or phenomenological experience in some other mode.
Philo's view on Torah is cited briefly but not directly quoted; PKD's paraphrase of Philo's position may be interpretive.
'Burning up your DNA scripts' ability to escape time'—highly speculative metaphor; unclear whether PKD means this literally or metaphorically.
